en: Okay guys, I look a little crazy right now.
zh: 好吧各位，我现在看起来有点奇怪。

en: I'm about to get my brows done.
zh: 我准备去修眉了。

en: I'm at the Benefit brow bar in the West Village.
zh: 我在西村的 Benefit 修眉吧。

en: They put on like a little eye mask and face mask while I wait.
zh: 他们让我戴上了一个眼罩和面膜，在等待的时候用的。

en: I'm very particular about like my eyebrows.
zh: 我对我的眉毛非常讲究。

en: I think it's because I had a really bad experience when I was younger and this lady like ripped off half my eyebrow.
zh: 我觉得是因为我小时候有一次很糟糕的经历，有个女士直接扯掉了我半边眉毛。

en: I'm very particular especially when I moved to a new place.
zh: 特别是当我搬到新地方的时候，我会更讲究。

en: I always like try to just find one person that I really like that I can just go to.
zh: 我总是会努力找一个我很喜欢、可以一直找她修眉的人。

en: and I won't ever leave them until I like have to for some reason.
zh: 一旦找到了，我就不会换，除非真的不得不换。

en: And this girl is great.
zh: 而这位女孩就很棒。

en: Sometimes I do threading and sometimes I do waxing.
zh: 有时候我会做线修，有时候做蜡脱。

en: I don't know what she's going to do today.
zh: 我不知道她今天会用哪种。

en: It doesn't really matter to me as long as it looks good which she always does here.
zh: 对我来说无所谓，只要效果好就行——而她每次都做得很好。

en: And then she also convinced me to start doing a brow tint when I come which I really like.
zh: 她还说服我每次来都做个眉毛染色，我挺喜欢的。

en: It's just like very subtle but it does kind of fill in the sparse areas of my brows.
zh: 染色很自然，但确实能填补我眉毛稀疏的地方。

en: and I don't really need to fill in my brows as much when I get them tinted.
zh: 而且染过之后，我平时几乎不用再补眉了。

en: So I'm like I might as well do it.
zh: 所以我就想，干脆每次都做吧。

en: But yeah I'm just waiting for my appointment to start.
zh: 总之我现在还在等我的预约开始。

en: Oh it's also a few days later by the way.
zh: 哦对了，顺便说一句，现在已经是几天后了。

en: It's a couple days after I got my hair done which it looks good.
zh: 是我做完头发后的几天，看起来还不错。

en: Can you see?
zh: 你能看出来吗？

en: Can you see?
zh: 你能看出来吗？

en: I don't know.
zh: 我也不确定。
